readme: Open registry of Claude settings (Brett, Nov 3 2026). A new setting is a new entry here, or in registry.d/*.json, or in the hub's claude/registry.json: no code change. owner: true = only Brett's signed-in console click changes it; owner: "raise" = anyone may lower it, only Brett raises it; locked: true = nobody changes it. tabs = the tabbed view (a group no tab lists shows under Other). level = the lowest settings level it shows at (simple, basic, developer, administrator).

groups.label: No wait
groups.description: Let Amber's held calls run at once instead of waiting on the 90 s veto. Only Brett's own click turns it on.

groups.label: Follow Amber
groups.description: Shared with the Follow Amber switch: one setting, read by both.

groups.label: Builds
groups.description: How Claude starts and pays for builds.

groups.label: Verification
groups.description: How much Claude trusts the live builds store.

groups.label: Talking
groups.description: How Amber talks to Brett (voice and chat).

groups.label: Notifications
groups.description: What gets pushed to the AmberX app, and when it stays quiet.

groups.label: Memory and notes

policyDefaults.readme: Brett, Nov 6 2026: hold only VPS writes and account switches. Only used to work out the 'Apply the default' plan; Brett's click applies it. Reads run at once; destructive tools keep the hub's confirm.

settings.label: No wait
settings.description: On: every call axHub would hold for Brett's veto runs at once (a standing all-scope veto pass, created by Brett's click). Off: back to the 90 s veto, and the pass is revoked at once.

settings.label: Include irreversible
settings.description: Also let irreversible calls (hard deletes, tools axHub marks irreversible) skip the confirm while No wait is on. Off by default.

settings.label: Stay on for
settings.description: How long No wait stays on once Brett turns it on. 'Until I turn it off' renews the pass before it ends.

settings.label: Turn off at night
settings.description: Switch No wait off by itself when the night window starts.

settings.label: Night starts
settings.description: Start of the night window (24 h clock, Brett's time zone).

settings.label: Night ends
settings.description: End of the night window.

settings.label: Follow Amber
settings.description: The console follows the screen Amber is working on. The same switch the Follow Amber build reads: one setting, never a copy.

settings.label: Default model
settings.description: Model for new builds. Split = the orchestrator pins each step to Opus or Fable. Whether an upgrade to Fable waits for Brett is the Fable upgrades setting.

settings.label: Fable upgrades need my approval
settings.description: Off (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "No more approvals. If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable."): a phase or step that needs Fable runs on Fable by itself and the switch is logged on the build. On: every Opus → Fable upgrade waits for your console click or axHub approval.

settings.label: Launch builds without asking
settings.description: On: Claude starts a build as soon as it is in the orchestrator, without a card asking first.

settings.label: Max parallel builds
settings.description: How many builds Claude runs at once (the VPS agent cap still applies on top).

settings.label: Budget per build (USD)
settings.description: A build that reaches this cost stops and notifies Brett. 0 = no cap. Anyone may lower it; only Brett raises it.

settings.label: Daily budget (USD)
settings.description: All builds together stop and notify Brett when the day's cost reaches this. 0 = no cap. Anyone may lower it; only Brett raises it.

settings.label: Always assign a named agent
settings.description: Every build is booked on a named agent's card. Locked on.

settings.label: UI Review gate
settings.description: A PR with UI waits for Brett's UI Review approval before it is called ready.

settings.label: Verify builds

options.label: Trust the live store, verify on conflict

settings.description: Trust the live builds store and check git/PRs only when they disagree (the current rule), or always check.

settings.label: Amber persona
settings.description: Talk as Amber (attitude, slang). Off = plain and polite.

settings.label: Tone level
settings.description: 1 = calm, 5 = full attitude.

settings.label: Call Brett
settings.description: Words Amber uses for Brett, comma-separated.

settings.label: Swearing
settings.description: How much Amber swears. Never slurs, whatever the level.

settings.label: Response length
settings.description: How long answers are.

settings.label: Say costs out loud
settings.description: Mention what a build or step cost when reporting it.

settings.label: Build reports
settings.description: Read build reports in full, or give the short summary.

settings.label: Build done
settings.description: Push when a build finishes.

settings.label: Build blocked
settings.description: Push when a build is stuck or needs Brett.

settings.label: Approval waiting
settings.description: Push when something waits for Brett's approval (model upgrades, recorder, passes).

settings.label: Quiet hours
settings.description: Hold pushes (except approvals) during quiet hours.

settings.label: Quiet from
settings.description: Start of quiet hours.

settings.label: Quiet until
settings.description: End of quiet hours.

settings.label: Save session notes to Notes Vault
settings.description: Each session saves its notes to the Notes Vault on its own.

settings.label: Handoff note at end of session
settings.description: Each session ends with a handoff note (what was done, what's left) in THREADS.md.
